pattern: (?i)^\s*(paralegal|paraprofessional|legal assistant|case assistant|project assistant|practice assistant|litigation support|legal secretary|clerk|law clerk|summer associate|intern)\b
note: Non-attorney timekeepers. First in priority because several of these strings contain a word that a later rule would claim -- "summer associate" is not an associate, and "law clerk" is not counsel.
Ranked above partner and associate because the bare title "Counsel" is its own grade at most US firms and must not fall through to "other".

Firms differ on whether a non-equity partner is a partner; this conforms them together and the limit is stated in the metric register. "Director" appears as a partner-equivalent grade at some firms and as a non-attorney grade at others -- a known imprecision, recorded rather than hidden.

"Attorney" with no grade is placed here rather than in "other" because an ungraded attorney is far more often an associate than a partner, and because leaving it unconformed would drop it out of the staffing-mix measure entirely. This is a judgment, and it is the weakest row in this file.
